dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Pretty Bear arrived at MACC as an owner surrender. Her previous owner describes her as a quiet social dog. While in care, Pretty has been observed to maintain a tense low body and tucked tail while with handlers. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an adult only home.
dog.name: Pretty Bear
